ayahs.ar: كٓهٰيٰعٓصٓ
ayahs.tl: Kaaaf-Haa-Yaa-'Ayyyn-Saaad
ayahs.en: Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad.

ayahs.ar: ذِكۡرُ رَحۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبۡدَهٗ زَكَرِيَّاۖۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Zikru rahmati Rabbika 'abdahoo Zakariyya
ayahs.en: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ نَادٰي رَبَّهٗ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Iz naadaa Rabbahoo nidaaa'an khafiyyaa
ayahs.en: When he called to his Lord a private supplication.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ وَهَنَ الۡعَظۡمُ مِنِّيۡ وَاشۡتَعَلَ الرَّاۡسُ شَيۡبًا وَّلَمۡ اَكُنۭۡ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbi innee wahanal'azmu minnee washta'alar raasu shaibanw wa lam akum bidu'aaa'ika Rabbi shaqiyyaa
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنِّيۡ خِفۡتُ الۡمَوَالِيَ مِنۡ وَّرَآءِيۡ وَكَانَتِ امۡرَاَتِيۡ عَاقِرًا فَهَبۡ لِيۡ مِنۡ لَّدُنۡكَ وَلِيًّاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa innee khiftul mawaa liya minw waraaa'ee wa kaana tim ra atee 'aairan fahab lee mil ladunka waliyyaa
ayahs.en: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir

ayahs.ar: يَّرِثُنِيۡ وَيَرِثُ مِنۡ اٰلِ يَعۡقُوۡبَࣗ وَاجۡعَلۡهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Yarisunee wa yarisu min aali Ya'qoob, waj'alhu Rabbi radiyya
ayahs.en: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."

ayahs.ar: يٰزَكَرِيَّا٘ اِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلٰمِ اِۨسۡمُهٗ يَحۡيٰيۙ لَمۡ نَجۡعَلۡ لَّهٗ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ سَمِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Yaa Zakariyyaaa innaa nubashshiruka bighulaami nismuhoo Yahyaa lam naj'al lahoo min qablu samiyyaa
ayahs.en: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اَنّٰي يَكُوۡنُ لِيۡ غُلٰمٌ وَّكَانَتِ امۡرَاَتِيۡ عَاقِرًا وَّقَدۡ بَلَغۡتُ مِنَ الۡكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbi annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamunw wa kaanatim ra atee aaqiranw wa qad balaghtu minal kibari 'itiyyaa
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَذٰلِكَۚ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ وَّقَدۡ خَلَقۡتُكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ تَكُ شَيۡـًٔا
ayahs.tl: Qaala kazaalika qaala Rabbuka huwa 'alaiya haiyinunw wa qad khalaqtuka min qablu wa lam taku shai'aa
ayahs.en: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.' "

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اجۡعَلۡ لِّيۡ٘ اٰيَةًؕ قَالَ اٰيَتُكَ اَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلٰثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbij 'al leee Aayah; qaala Aayatuka allaa tukalliman naasa salaasa layaalin sawiyyaa
ayahs.en: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."

ayahs.ar: فَخَرَجَ عَلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ مِنَ الۡمِحۡرَابِ فَاَوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيۡهِمۡ اَنۡ سَبِّحُوۡا بُكۡرَةً وَّعَشِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Fakharaja 'alaa qawmihee minal mihraabi fa-awhaaa ilaihim an sabbihoo bukratanw wa 'ashiyyaa
ayahs.en: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon.

ayahs.ar: يٰيَحۡيٰي خُذِ الۡكِتٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍؕ وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُ الۡحُكۡمَ صَبِيًّاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaa Yahyaa khuzil Kitaaba biquwwatinw wa aatainaahul hukma saiyyaa
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "O John, take the Scripture with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy

ayahs.ar: وَّحَنَانًا مِّنۡ لَّدُنَّا وَزَكٰوةًؕ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa hanaanam mil ladunnaa wa zakaatanw wa kaana taqiyyaa
ayahs.en: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah

ayahs.ar: وَّبَرًّاۭ بِوَالِدَيۡهِ وَلَمۡ يَكُنۡ جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Wa barram biwaalidayhi wa lam yakum jabbaaran 'asiyyaa
ayahs.en: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.

ayahs.ar: وَسَلٰمٌ عَلَيۡهِ يَوۡمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوۡمَ يَمُوۡتُ وَيَوۡمَ يُبۡعَثُ حَيًّاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa salaamun 'alaihi yawma wulida wa yawma yamootu wa yawma yub'asu haiyaa
ayahs.en: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.

ayahs.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ فِي الۡكِتٰبِ مَرۡيَمَۘ اِذِ انۡتَبَذَتۡ مِنۡ اَهۡلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرۡقِيًّاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Marya; izin tabazat min ahlihaa makaanan shariqyyaa
ayahs.en: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.

ayahs.ar: فَاتَّخَذَتۡ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِمۡ حِجَابًاࣞ فَاَرۡسَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهَا رُوۡحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Fattakhazat min doonihim hijaaban fa arsalnaaa ilaihaa roohanaa fatamassala lahaa basharan sawiyyaa
ayahs.en: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.

ayahs.ar: قَالَتۡ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَعُوۡذُ بِالرَّحۡمٰنِ مِنۡكَ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ تَقِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Qaalat inneee a'oozu bir Rahmaani minka in kunta taqiyyaa
ayahs.en: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allah."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنَّمَا٘ اَنَا رَسُوۡلُ رَبِّكِࣗۖ لِاَهَبَ لَكِ غُلٰمًا زَكِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Qaala innamaa ana rasoolu Rabbiki li ahaba laki ghulaaman zakiyyaa
ayahs.en: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy."

ayahs.ar: قَالَتۡ اَنّٰي يَكُوۡنُ لِيۡ غُلٰمٌ وَّلَمۡ يَمۡسَسۡنِيۡ بَشَرٌ وَّلَمۡ اَكُ بَغِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Qaalat anna yakoonu lee ghulaamunw wa lam yamsasnee bashrunw wa lam aku baghiyyaa
ayahs.en: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَذٰلِكِۚ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌۚ وَلِنَجۡعَلَهٗ٘ اٰيَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحۡمَةً مِّنَّاۚ وَكَانَ اَمۡرًا مَّقۡضِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Qaala kazaaliki qaala Rabbuki huwa 'alaiya yaiyimunw wa linaj 'alahooo Aayatal linnaasi wa rahmatam minnaa; wa kaana amram maqdiyyaa
ayahs.en: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.' "

ayahs.ar: فَحَمَلَتۡهُ فَانۡتَبَذَتۡ بِهٖ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Fahamalat hu fantabazat bihee makaanan qasiyyaa
ayahs.en: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.

ayahs.ar: فَاَجَآءَهَا الۡمَخَاضُ اِلٰي جِذۡعِ النَّخۡلَةِۚ قَالَتۡ يٰلَيۡتَنِيۡ مِتُّ قَبۡلَ هٰذَا وَكُنۡتُ نَسۡيًا مَّنۡسِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Fa ajaaa 'ahal makhaadu ilaa jiz'in nakhlati qaalat yaa laitanee mittu qabla haazaa wa kuntu nasyam mansiyyaa
ayahs.en: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."

ayahs.ar: فَنَادٰىهَا مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا٘ اَلَّا تَحۡزَنِيۡ قَدۡ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحۡتَكِ سَرِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Fanaadaahaa min tahtihaan allaa tahzanee qad ja'ala Rabbuki tahtaki sariyyaa
ayahs.en: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.

ayahs.ar: وَهُزِّيۡ٘ اِلَيۡكِ بِجِذۡعِ النَّخۡلَةِ تُسٰقِطۡ عَلَيۡكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّاؗ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa huzzeee ilaiki bijiz 'in nakhlati tusaaqit 'alaiki rutaban janiyyaa
ayahs.en: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.

ayahs.ar: فَكُلِيۡ وَاشۡرَبِيۡ وَقَرِّيۡ عَيۡنًاۚ فَاِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ الۡبَشَرِ اَحَدًاۙ فَقُوۡلِيۡ٘ اِنِّيۡ نَذَرۡتُ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ صَوۡمًا فَلَنۡ اُكَلِّمَ الۡيَوۡمَ اِنۡسِيًّاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Fakulee washrabee wa qarree 'ainaa; fa immaa tarayinnna minal bashari ahadan faqooleee innee nazartu lir Rahmaani sawman falan ukallimal yawma insiyyaa
ayahs.en: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' "

ayahs.ar: فَاَتَتۡ بِهٖ قَوۡمَهَا تَحۡمِلُهٗؕ قَالُوۡا يٰمَرۡيَمُ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتِ شَيۡـًٔا فَرِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Fa atat bihee qawmahaa tahmiluhoo qaaloo yaa Maryamoo laqad ji'ti shai'an fariyyaa
ayahs.en: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اُخۡتَ هٰرُوۡنَ مَا كَانَ اَبُوۡكِ امۡرَاَ سَوۡءٍ وَّمَا كَانَتۡ اُمُّكِ بَغِيًّاۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaaa ukkhta Haaroona maa kaana abokim ra-a saw'inw wa maa kaanat ummuki baghiyyaa
ayahs.en: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."

ayahs.ar: فَاَشَارَتۡ اِلَيۡهِؕࣞ قَالُوۡا كَيۡفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَنۡ كَانَ فِي الۡمَهۡدِ صَبِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Fa ashaarat ilaih; qaaloo kaifa nukallimu man kaana fil mahdi sabiyyaa
ayahs.en: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنِّيۡ عَبۡدُ اللّٰهِؕࣞ اٰتٰىنِيَ الۡكِتٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِيۡ نَبِيًّاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala innee 'abdullaahi aataaniyal Kitaaba wa ja'alanee Nabiyyaa
ayahs.en: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.

ayahs.ar: وَّجَعَلَنِيۡ مُبٰرَكًا اَيۡنَ مَا كُنۡتُࣕ وَاَوۡصٰنِيۡ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَالزَّكٰوةِ مَا دُمۡتُ حَيًّاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ja'alanee mubaarakan aina maa kuntu wa awsaanee bis Salaati waz Zakaati maa dumtu haiyaa
ayahs.en: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive

ayahs.ar: وَّبَرًّاۭ بِوَالِدَتِيۡؗ وَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡنِيۡ جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Wa barram biwaalidatee wa lam yaj'alnee jabbaaran shaqiyyaa
ayahs.en: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.

ayahs.ar: وَالسَّلٰمُ عَلَيَّ يَوۡمَ وُلِدۡتُّ وَيَوۡمَ اَمُوۡتُ وَيَوۡمَ اُبۡعَثُ حَيًّا
ayahs.tl: Wassalaamu 'alaiya yawma wulittu wa yawma amootu wa yawma ub'asu baiyaa
ayahs.en: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ عِيۡسَي ابۡنُ مَرۡيَمَۚ قَوۡلَ الۡحَقِّ الَّذِيۡ فِيۡهِ يَمۡتَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Zaalika 'Eesab-nu Marya; qawlal haqqil lazee feehi yamtaroon
ayahs.en: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.

ayahs.ar: مَا كَانَ لِلّٰهِ اَنۡ يَّتَّخِذَ مِنۡ وَّلَدٍۙ سُبۡحٰنَهٗؕ اِذَا قَضٰ٘ي اَمۡرًا فَاِنَّمَا يَقُوۡلُ لَهٗ كُنۡ فَيَكُوۡنُؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Maa kaana lillaahi ai yattakhiza minw waladin Subhaanah; izaa qadaaa amran fa innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fa yakoon
ayahs.en: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ رَبِّيۡ وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَاعۡبُدُوۡهُؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa innal laaha Rabbee wa Rabbukum fa'budooh; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem
ayahs.en: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."

ayahs.ar: فَاخۡتَلَفَ الۡاَحۡزَابُ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِهِمۡۚ فَوَيۡلٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ مَّشۡهَدِ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Fakhtalafal ahzaabu mim bainihim fawailul lillazeena kafaroo mim mashhadi Yawmin 'azeem
ayahs.en: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.

ayahs.ar: اَسۡمِعۡ بِهِمۡ وَاَبۡصِرۡۙ يَوۡمَ يَاۡتُوۡنَنَا لٰكِنِ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ الۡيَوۡمَ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Asmi' bihim wa absir Yawma yaatoonanaa laakiniz zaalimoonal yawma fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.en: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.

ayahs.ar: وَاَنۡذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡحَسۡرَةِ اِذۡ قُضِيَ الۡاَمۡرُۘ وَهُمۡ فِيۡ غَفۡلَةٍ وَّهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa anzirhum Yawmal hasrati iz qudiyal amr; wa hum fee ghaflatinw wa hum laa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَرِثُ الۡاَرۡضَ وَمَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا وَاِلَيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa NNahnu narisul arda wa man 'alaihaa wa ilainaa yurja'oon
ayahs.en: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.

ayahs.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ فِي الۡكِتٰبِ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ ࣢ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ صِدِّيۡقًا نَّبِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Ibraaheem; innahoo kaana siddeeqan Nabiyyaa
ayahs.en: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لِاَبِيۡهِ يٰ٘اَبَتِ لِمَ تَعۡبُدُ مَا لَا يَسۡمَعُ وَلَا يُبۡصِرُ وَلَا يُغۡنِيۡ عَنۡكَ شَيۡـًٔا
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala li abeehi yaaa abati lima ta'budu maa laa yasma'u wa laa yubsiru wa laa yughnee 'anka shai'aa
ayahs.en: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَبَتِ اِنِّيۡ قَدۡ جَآءَنِيۡ مِنَ الۡعِلۡمِ مَا لَمۡ يَاۡتِكَ فَاتَّبِعۡنِيۡ٘ اَهۡدِكَ صِرَاطًا سَوِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Yaaa abati innee qad jaaa'anee minal 'ilmi maa lam yaatika fattabi'neee ahdika siraatan Sawiyyaa
ayahs.en: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَبَتِ لَا تَعۡبُدِ الشَّيۡطٰنَؕ اِنَّ الشَّيۡطٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ عَصِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Yaaa abati laa ta'budish Shaitaana innash Shaitaana kaana lir Rahmaani 'asiyyaa
ayahs.en: O my father, do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَبَتِ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ اَنۡ يَّمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ فَتَكُوۡنَ لِلشَّيۡطٰنِ وَلِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Yaaa abati innee akhaafu ai yamssaka 'azaabum minar Rahmaani fatakoona lish Shaitaani waliyyaa
ayahs.en: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَرَاغِبٌ اَنۡتَ عَنۡ اٰلِهَتِيۡ يٰ٘اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُۚ لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَهِ لَاَرۡجُمَنَّكَ وَاهۡجُرۡنِيۡ مَلِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Qaala araaghibun anta 'an aalihatee yaaa Ibraaheemu la 'il lam tantahi la arjumannaka wahjumee maliyyaa
ayahs.en: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيۡكَۚ سَاَسۡتَغۡفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّيۡؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ بِيۡ حَفِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Qaala salaamun 'alaika sa astaghfiru laka Rabbeee innahoo kaana bee hafiyyaa
ayahs.en: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.

ayahs.ar: وَاَعۡتَزِلُكُمۡ وَمَا تَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ وَاَدۡعُوۡا رَبِّيۡؗۖ عَسٰ٘ي اَلَّا٘ اَكُوۡنَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّيۡ شَقِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Wa a'tazilukum wa maa tad'oona min doonil laahi wa ad'o Rabbee 'asaaa allaaa akoona bidu'aaa'i Rabbee shaqiyyaa
ayahs.en: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا اعۡتَزَلَهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِۙ وَهَبۡنَا لَهٗ٘ اِسۡحٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَؕ وَكُلًّا جَعَلۡنَا نَبِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Falamma' tazalahum wa maa ya'budoona min doonil laahi wahabnaa lahoo is-haaqa wa ya'qoob, wa kullan ja'alnaa Nabiyyaa
ayahs.en: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ رَّحۡمَتِنَا وَجَعَلۡنَا لَهُمۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ عَلِيًّاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa wahabnaa lahum mirrahmatinaa wa ja'alnaa lahum lisaana sidqin 'aliyyaa
ayahs.en: And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor.

ayahs.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ فِي الۡكِتٰبِ مُوۡسٰ٘يؗ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مُخۡلَصًا وَّكَانَ رَسُوۡلًا نَّبِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Moosaaa; innahoo kaana mukhlasanw wa kaana Rasoolan Nabiyyaa
ayahs.en: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.

ayahs.ar: وَنَادَيۡنٰهُ مِنۡ جَانِبِ الطُّوۡرِ الۡاَيۡمَنِ وَقَرَّبۡنٰهُ نَجِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Wa naadainaahu min jaanibit Tooril aimani wa qarrabnaahu najiyyaa
ayahs.en: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهٗ مِنۡ رَّحۡمَتِنَا٘ اَخَاهُ هٰرُوۡنَ نَبِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Wa wahabnaa lahoo mir rahmatinaaa akhaahu Haaroona Nabiyyaa
ayahs.en: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.

ayahs.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ فِي الۡكِتٰبِ اِسۡمٰعِيۡلَؗ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ صَادِقَ الۡوَعۡدِ وَكَانَ رَسُوۡلًا نَّبِيًّاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wazkur fil Kitaabi ismaa'eel; innahoo kaana saadiqal wa'di wa kaana Rasoolan Nabiyyaa
ayahs.en: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.

ayahs.ar: وَكَانَ يَاۡمُرُ اَهۡلَهٗ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَالزَّكٰوةِࣕ وَكَانَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهٖ مَرۡضِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Wa kaana yaamuru ahlahoo bis Salaati waz zakaati wa kaana 'inda Rabbihee mardiyyaa
ayahs.en: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing.

ayahs.ar: وَاذۡكُرۡ فِي الۡكِتٰبِ اِدۡرِيۡسَؗ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ صِدِّيۡقًا نَّبِيًّاࣗۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Idrees; innahoo kaana siddeeqan Nabiyyaa
ayahs.en: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.

ayahs.ar: وَّرَفَعۡنٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Wa rafa'naahu makaanan 'aliyyaa
ayahs.en: And We raised him to a high station.

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَنۡعَمَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنَ النَّبِيّٖنَ مِنۡ ذُرِّيَّةِ اٰدَمَࣗ وَمِمَّنۡ حَمَلۡنَا مَعَ نُوۡحٍؗ وَّمِنۡ ذُرِّيَّةِ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَاِسۡرَآءِيۡلَؗ وَمِمَّنۡ هَدَيۡنَا وَاجۡتَبَيۡنَاؕ اِذَا تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتُ الرَّحۡمٰنِ خَرُّوۡا سُجَّدًا وَّبُكِيًّاࣛ‏
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena an'amal laahu 'alaihim minan Nabiyyeena min zurriyyati Aadama wa mimman hamalnaa ma'a Noohinw wa min zurriyyati Ibraaheema wa Israaa'eela wa mimman hadainaa wajta bainaaa; izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatur Rahmaani kharroo sujjadanw wa bukiyyaa
ayahs.en: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.

ayahs.ar: فَخَلَفَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡ خَلۡفٌ اَضَاعُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوٰتِ فَسَوۡفَ يَلۡقَوۡنَ غَيًّاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fakhalafa mim ba'dihim khalfun adaa'us Salaata wattaba'ush shahawaati fasawfa yalqawna ghaiyaa
ayahs.en: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا مَنۡ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَاُولٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُوۡنَ الۡجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ شَيۡـًٔاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Illaa man taaba wa aamana wa 'amila saalihan fa ulaaa'ika yadkhuloonal jannata wa laa yuzlamoona shai'aa
ayahs.en: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.

ayahs.ar: جَنّٰتِ عَدۡنِ اِۨلَّتِيۡ وَعَدَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ عِبَادَهٗ بِالۡغَيۡبِؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ وَعۡدُهٗ مَاۡتِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Jannaati 'adninil latee wa'adar Rahmaanu ibaadahoo bilghaib; innahoo kaana wa'duhoo maatiyyaa
ayahs.en: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming.

ayahs.ar: لَا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا لَغۡوًا اِلَّا سَلٰمًاؕ وَلَهُمۡ رِزۡقُهُمۡ فِيۡهَا بُكۡرَةً وَّعَشِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwan illaa salaamaa; wa lahum rizquhum feehaa bukratanw wa 'ashiyyaa
ayahs.en: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.

ayahs.ar: تِلۡكَ الۡجَنَّةُ الَّتِيۡ نُوۡرِثُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا مَنۡ كَانَ تَقِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Tilkal jannatul latee oorisu min 'ibaadinaa man kaana taqiyyaa
ayahs.en: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ اِلَّا بِاَمۡرِ رَبِّكَۚ لَهٗ مَا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡنَا وَمَا خَلۡفَنَا وَمَا بَيۡنَ ذٰلِكَۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa natanazzalu illaa bi amri Rabbika lahoo maa baina aideenaa wa maa khalfanaa wa maa baina zaalik; wa maa kaana Rabbuka nasiyyaa
ayahs.en: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -

ayahs.ar: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فَاعۡبُدۡهُ وَاصۡطَبِرۡ لِعِبَادَتِهٖؕ هَلۡ تَعۡلَمُ لَهٗ سَمِيًّاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa fa'bud hu wastabir li'ibaadatih; hal ta'lamu lahoo samiyyaa
ayahs.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ ءَاِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوۡفَ اُخۡرَجُ حَيًّا
ayahs.tl: Wa yaqoolul insaanu 'aizaa maa mittu lasawfa ukhraju haiyaa
ayahs.en: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَا يَذۡكُرُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ اَنَّا خَلَقۡنٰهُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَلَمۡ يَكُ شَيۡـًٔا
ayahs.tl: awalaa yazkurul insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min qablu wa lam yaku shai'aa
ayahs.en: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?

ayahs.ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحۡشُرَنَّهُمۡ وَالشَّيٰطِيۡنَ ثُمَّ لَنُحۡضِرَنَّهُمۡ حَوۡلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Fawa Rabbika lanahshu rannahum wash shayaateena summa lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jisiyyaa
ayahs.en: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ لَنَنۡزِعَنَّ مِنۡ كُلِّ شِيۡعَةٍ اَيُّهُمۡ اَشَدُّ عَلَي الرَّحۡمٰنِ عِتِيًّاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Summa lananzi 'anna min kulli shee'atin aiyuhum ashaddu 'alar Rahmaani 'itiyyaa
ayahs.en: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ لَنَحۡنُ اَعۡلَمُ بِالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ اَوۡلٰي بِهَا صِلِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Summa lanahnu a'lamu billazeena hum awlaa bihaa siliyyaa
ayahs.en: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ مِّنۡكُمۡ اِلَّا وَارِدُهَاۚ كَانَ عَلٰي رَبِّكَ حَتۡمًا مَّقۡضِيًّاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa im minkum illaa waa riduhaa; kaana 'alaa Rabbika hatmam maqdiyyaa
ayahs.en: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوۡا وَّنَذَرُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا جِثِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Summa nunajjil lazeenat taqaw wa nazaruz zaalimeena feehaa jisiyyaa
ayahs.en: Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنٰتٍ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘اۙ اَيُّ الۡفَرِيۡقَيۡنِ خَيۡرٌ مَّقَامًا وَّاَحۡسَنُ نَدِيًّا
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatunaa baiyinaatin qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo aiyul fareeqaini khairum maqaamanw wa ahsanu nadiyyaa
ayahs.en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"

ayahs.ar: وَكَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ اَحۡسَنُ اَثَاثًا وَّرِئۡيًا
ayahs.tl: Wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu asaasanw wa ri'yaa
ayahs.en: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ مَنۡ كَانَ فِي الضَّلٰلَةِ فَلۡيَمۡدُدۡ لَهُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ مَدًّا ࣢ۚ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا رَاَوۡا مَا يُوۡعَدُوۡنَ اِمَّا الۡعَذَابَ وَاِمَّا السَّاعَةَ ࣢ؕ فَسَيَعۡلَمُوۡنَ مَنۡ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَّاَضۡعَفُ جُنۡدًا
ayahs.tl: Qul man kaana fidda laalati falyamdud lahur Rahmaanu maddaa; hattaaa izaa ra aw maa yoo'adoona immal 'azaaba wa immas Saa'ata fasa ya'lamoona man huwa sharrum makaananw wa ad'afu jundaa
ayahs.en: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."

ayahs.ar: وَيَزِيۡدُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ اهۡتَدَوۡا هُدًيؕ وَالۡبٰقِيٰتُ الصّٰلِحٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَّخَيۡرٌ مَّرَدًّا
ayahs.tl: Wa yazeedul laahul lazeenah tadaw hudaa; wal baaqiyaatus saalihaatu khairun 'inda Rabbika sawaabanw wa khairum maraddaa
ayahs.en: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.

ayahs.ar: اَفَرَءَيۡتَ الَّذِيۡ كَفَرَ بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَاُوۡتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَّوَلَدًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Afara'aytal lazee kafara bi Aayaatinaa wa qaala la oota yanna maalanw wa waladaa
ayahs.en: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]?"

ayahs.ar: اَطَّلَعَ الۡغَيۡبَ اَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِنۡدَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ عَهۡدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Attala'al ghaiba amitta khaza'indar Rahmaani 'ahdaa
ayahs.en: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?

ayahs.ar: كَلَّاؕ سَنَكۡتُبُ مَا يَقُوۡلُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهٗ مِنَ الۡعَذَابِ مَدًّاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Kallaa; sanaktubu maa yaqoolu wa namuddu lahoo minal 'azaabi maddaa
ayahs.en: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively.

ayahs.ar: وَّنَرِثُهٗ مَا يَقُوۡلُ وَيَاۡتِيۡنَا فَرۡدًا
ayahs.tl: Wa narisuhoo maa yaqoolu wa yaateenaa fardaa
ayahs.en: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.

ayahs.ar: وَاتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اٰلِهَةً لِّيَكُوۡنُوۡا لَهُمۡ عِزًّاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal liyakoonoo lahum 'izzaa
ayahs.en: And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.

ayahs.ar: كَلَّاؕ سَيَكۡفُرُوۡنَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمۡ وَيَكُوۡنُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضِدًّاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Kallaa; sa yakfuroona bi'ibaadatihim wa yakoonoona 'alaihim diddaa
ayahs.en: No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اَنَّا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا الشَّيٰطِيۡنَ عَلَي الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ تَؤُزُّهُمۡ اَزًّاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Alam tara annaaa arsalnash Shayaateena 'alal kaafireena ta'uzzuhum azzaa
ayahs.en: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement?

ayahs.ar: فَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡؕ اِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمۡ عَدًّاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Falaa ta'jal alaihim innamaa na 'uddu lahum 'addaa
ayahs.en: So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number.

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ اِلَي الرَّحۡمٰنِ وَفۡدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Yawma nahshurul muttaqeena ilar Rahmaani wafdaa
ayahs.en: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation

ayahs.ar: وَّنَسُوۡقُ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ اِلٰي جَهَنَّمَ وِرۡدًاۘ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa nasooqul mujrimeena ilaa Jahannama wirdaa
ayahs.en: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst

ayahs.ar: لَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ الشَّفَاعَةَ اِلَّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِنۡدَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ عَهۡدًاۘ‏
ayahs.tl: Laa yamlikoonash shafaa'ta illaa manittakhaza 'indar Rahmaani 'ahdaa
ayahs.en: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَلَدًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalut takhazar Rahmaanu waladaa
ayahs.en: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."

ayahs.ar: لَقَدۡ جِئۡتُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا اِدًّاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Laqad ji'tum shai'an iddaa
ayahs.en: You have done an atrocious thing.

ayahs.ar: تَكَادُ السَّمٰوٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَتَنۡشَقُّ الۡاَرۡضُ وَتَخِرُّ الۡجِبَالُ هَدًّاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Takaadus samaawaatu yatafattarna minhu wa tanshaq qul ardu wa takhirrul jibaalu haddaa
ayahs.en: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation

ayahs.ar: اَنۡ دَعَوۡا لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ وَلَدًاۚ‏
ayahs.tl: An da'aw lir Rahmaani waladaa
ayahs.en: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَنۭۡ بَغِيۡ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ اَنۡ يَّتَّخِذَ وَلَدًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa yambaghee lir Rahmaani ai yattakhiza waladaa
ayahs.en: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ كُلُّ مَنۡ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّا٘ اٰتِي الرَّحۡمٰنِ عَبۡدًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: In kullu man fis samaawaati wal ardi illaaa aatir Rahmaani 'abdaa
ayahs.en: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.

ayahs.ar: لَقَدۡ اَحۡصٰىهُمۡ وَعَدَّهُمۡ عَدًّاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Laqad ahsaahum wa addahum 'addaa
ayahs.en: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.

ayahs.ar: وَكُلُّهُمۡ اٰتِيۡهِ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فَرۡدًا
ayahs.tl: Wa kulluhum aateehi Yawmal Qiyaamati fardaa
ayahs.en: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ سَيَجۡعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وُدًّا
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati sa yaj'alu lahumur Rahmaanu wuddaa
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.

ayahs.ar: فَاِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ وَتُنۡذِرَ بِهٖ قَوۡمًا لُّدًّا
ayahs.tl: Fa innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika litubashshira bihil muttaqeena wa tunzira bihee qawmal luddaa
ayahs.en: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.

ayahs.ar: وَكَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡنٍؕ هَلۡ تُحِسُّ مِنۡهُمۡ مِّنۡ اَحَدٍ اَوۡ تَسۡمَعُ لَهُمۡ رِكۡزًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa kam ahlaknaa qabla hum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasma'u lahum rikzaa
ayahs.en: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
